text:
### Third-Party Access  
**Contractor/Vendor Access:**
- Limited to systems needed
- Time-bound (auto-revocation)
- Monitored (all actions logged)
- MFA required
- NDA and security agreement signed  
---
name: Chunk 20/32

raw_entities.name: Third-Party Access Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing access by contractors and vendors to bank systems, establishing principles of least privilege, time-bound access, continuous monitoring, and mandatory security agreements. The policy mandates multi-factor authentication and automatic revocation of access rights.
context: Contractor/Vendor Access: Limited to systems needed, Time-bound (auto-revocation), Monitored (all actions logged), MFA required, NDA and security agreement signed

raw_entities.name: Contractor and Vendor System Access Limitation
raw_entities.description: Requirement that contractor and vendor access to bank systems be restricted to only those systems necessary for their contracted work, implementing the principle of least privilege.

raw_entities.name: Time-Bound Access with Automatic Revocation
raw_entities.description: Requirement that all third-party access grants be time-limited with automatic revocation upon expiry, preventing indefinite or orphaned access rights.

raw_entities.name: Comprehensive Logging of Third-Party Actions
raw_entities.description: Requirement that all actions performed by contractors and vendors on bank systems be logged and monitored to enable audit trails and detection of unauthorized or suspicious activity.

raw_entities.name: Multi-Factor Authentication for Third-Party Access
raw_entities.description: Requirement that all contractors and vendors must authenticate using multi-factor authentication when accessing bank systems, strengthening access controls beyond single-factor credentials.

raw_entities.name: Non-Disclosure Agreement and Security Agreement Execution
raw_entities.description: Requirement that contractors and vendors must execute both a Non-Disclosure Agreement and a security agreement prior to being granted access to bank systems, establishing legal and contractual obligations.

raw_entities.name: Access Control Limitation
raw_entities.description: Operational control restricting third-party system access to only those systems required for contracted duties, implementing least-privilege principles.

raw_entities.name: Automatic Access Revocation
raw_entities.description: Technical control mechanism that automatically terminates third-party access rights upon expiry of the time-bound access grant, preventing access persistence beyond authorized periods.

raw_entities.name: Audit Logging of Third-Party Actions
raw_entities.description: Monitoring and logging control that records all actions performed by contractors and vendors on bank systems, enabling forensic review and compliance verification.

raw_entities.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
raw_entities.description: Authentication control requiring contractors and vendors to use multiple authentication factors when accessing bank systems, reducing the risk of unauthorized access through credential compromise.

raw_entities.name: Third-Party Access Administrator
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for managing, monitoring, and enforcing third-party access controls, including provisioning, time-bound grants, and revocation of contractor and vendor system access.
context: Contractor/Vendor Access: Limited to systems needed, Time-bound (auto-revocation), Monitored (all actions logged)

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Access
raw_entities.description: Risk that contractors or vendors may gain access to systems beyond their contracted scope or retain access after engagement termination, potentially enabling data theft, fraud, or system compromise.

raw_entities.name: Undetected Malicious Activity by Third Parties
raw_entities.description: Risk that contractors or vendors may perform unauthorized or malicious actions on bank systems without detection, compromising data integrity or system availability.

raw_entities.name: Credential Compromise of Third-Party Users
raw_entities.description: Risk that contractor or vendor credentials may be compromised, allowing unauthorized actors to impersonate legitimate third-party users and access bank systems.

properties.core_policy_statement: Third-party contractors and vendors are granted limited, time-bound system access with mandatory multi-factor authentication, comprehensive action logging, and automatic revocation, contingent on execution of non-disclosure and security agreements.
properties.scope_summary: Applies to all contractor and vendor access to bank systems. Excludes internal employees covered under separate access policies.

properties.name: Contractor and Vendor System Access Limitation

properties.consequence_of_breach: Unauthorized system access; potential data breach or fraud
properties.verification_method: Access control lists reviewed at onboarding and periodically
Automated system revocation; access logs reviewed

properties.consequence_of_breach: Inability to detect or investigate malicious activity
properties.verification_method: Audit logs retained and reviewed for anomalies

properties.name: Non-Disclosure Agreement and Security Agreement Execution

properties.consequence_of_breach: Legal liability; access denial; contract termination
properties.verification_method: Signed agreements retained in personnel file prior to access grant

properties.evidence_required: Comprehensive audit logs retained for investigation

specific_obligation: Grant access limited to systems needed by contractor/vendor
Enforce time-bound access with automatic revocation
Verify execution of NDA and security agreements prior to access grant
Monitor and review audit logs of third-party actions
properties.accountability_for: Ensuring third-party access complies with policy controls and is revoked on schedule

properties.risk_definition: Third-party users gaining access to systems beyond their authorized scope or after access expiration
examples: contractor accessing systems not required for their role
vendor retaining access after contract termination
properties.detection_mechanism: Access control list review; audit log analysis
properties.required_response: Immediate access revocation; investigation of unauthorized actions

properties.name: Undetected Malicious Activity by Third Parties

properties.risk_definition: Third-party users performing malicious actions (data theft, system manipulation) without detection
properties.detection_mechanism: Comprehensive audit logging; anomaly detection in access patterns
properties.required_response: Immediate investigation; escalation to security team; potential law enforcement notification

properties.risk_definition: Third-party user credentials stolen or compromised, enabling unauthorized impersonation
properties.detection_mechanism: Multi-factor authentication prevents unauthorized use; audit logs reveal anomalous access patterns
properties.required_response: Immediate credential reset; access revocation; investigation of actions taken with compromised credentials
